title: MaleTheme Solo #011 · 남 머슬 모델·플럼 스모키·해적 테마·투톤
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sunlit arches of the Roman Colosseum with worn stone paving, standard-height arched doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Vietnamese man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth warm light-tan skin, a bright open smile showing his teeth, cool ash-brown hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a tin ship's anchor, a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold rings. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black tricorn pirate hat with a white skull emblem, a red bandana knotted at his neck, black leather wrist cuffs with gold studs, and a minimal black and white two-tone leather with gold and white two-tone buckles T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme gold platform loafers with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
